scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix shared --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix shared && npm install --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix shared && npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
